description:
Brand introduction & product description

Welcome to our world of lovingly made bath and body products! Our soaping story began in 2010 when we embarked on a mission to create extra special holiday gifts for our coworkers, family, and friends. The response was overwhelming, as our handmade gifts were adored by all. It wasn't long before people started asking where they could buy more.

Driven by the joy of creating bath and body items that everyone loves, our passion blossomed. We expanded our selection to include beautifully handmade Soap, Bath Bombs, Bath Salts, Body Lotions, Lotion Candles, Body Sprays, Lip Balms, and an array of other giftable delights. We understand that even manly men deserve pampering, which is why we offer a whole line of Beard Oils, Beard Balms, and even the Men's Maintenance Kit - where you can select everything needed to tame that manly mane! Don't worry; we've got those men who shave covered, too! With a vast selection of shave soaps and aftershaves just for you!

We look forward to sharing our passion for lovingly made bath and body products with you. Talk with you soon!

USP (Unique Selling Point)

Everything is handmade right here in Landis, North Carolina, in our warehouse. We have shipped our lovingly made products all over the world and to every state within the United States. We provide the best possible bath and body products only using the best possible sustainably sourced ingredients.

Payment terms

Commissions are paid on the 30th of each month for the preceding month. (For example, all July commissions will be paid out on August 30th.) We have a $100 minimum commission threshold before payment. Please send us your bank details or upload them to your affiliate account. You can also choose to be paid with in-store credit.

Cookie Days

Your referral link has 365 cookie days, which means that if the first link a customer used to access our website were yours, you would receive a commission for it, even if it isn’t the link they purchased our product on. This ensures that you are credited where credit is due!

Multi-Level Marketing

If you would like to recommend an affiliate to us, you can gain a 5% commission on their sales. This hugely increases your commission-earning potential! Please login to your account, navigate to the ‘Network’ tab, and find your Network Link. Please send this to the potential affiliates you’d like to refer so they can sign up.

Other information

All products are Phthalate and sulfate-free. Each product recipe has been developed using the best possible ingredients and has never been tested on animals. Many hours go into the research and development of each product, ensuring that the chosen ingredients are the best possible ingredients for the best possible results when used. Our company is woman-owned and operated. Our facility has been designed to allow working moms to bring their children to work, saving them childcare expenses with our entertainment and work-free zone just for the kids! We are 100% about family and family oriented.
